title: Watch Stewart Brand’s 6‑Part Series How Buildings Learn, With Music by Brian Eno
content: Stewart Brand came onto the cultural scene during the 1960s, helping to stage the Acid Tests made famous by Ken Kesey and the Merry Pranksters, and later launching the influential Whole Earth Catalog (something Steve Jobs described as “Google in paperback form, 35 years before Google came along”).
